provenance.notes: REBUILT from source-lift offender. Real NukeSentinel nukesentinel.php (all 3 versions from SourceForge tarballs) runs unmodified inside PHP 5.6 + Apache + MariaDB. The PHP-Nuke environment (config.php, db/db.php, lang file, getusrinfo/is_admin) is a minimal shim providing the runtime context the real include expects. The real ereg() IP validation + raw-interpolated INSERT sink execute as published. External HTTP trigger via Client-IP header. Payloads adapted for the real 14-column INSERT (no comma-space to avoid get_ip() proxy-chain split). Benign: injection only reads the planted pcb_secret canary. See repro.log.
